scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()) { res.writeHead(200); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }); server.listen(3333, () => console.log('SASBOV running at http://localhost:3333'));"

author: SASBOV MARKET
